newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING had excellent first quarter of 1997.
newsitem.headline: ING had excellent first quarter of 1997.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Tuesday it had made an excellent start in the first three months of 1997.
"I believe we made a good start. The first quarter will look excellent," executive board chairman Aad Jacobs told ING's annual shareholders' meeting.
Jacobs declined to give profit forecast for the full year and he did not specify details of the first quarter results.
"Despite a good start to this year, we remain careful," he said. ING will publish its results for the first quarter of 1997 on May 29.

In 1996, the company posted a first quarter net profit of 736 million guilders, up 41.5 percent from 520 million in the first three months of 1995. The 1996 full-year net grew by 25.4 percent to 3.32 billion guilders. In April, it said it was confident about business in 1997 but added it was too early to make a full-year profit forecast.
